# JCR weather
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
jcr_weather <- read_csv(
  "data/Weather Data/Jalama Canyon Ranch Weather Station Data_10022024.csv"
)

# check col types
sapply(jcr_weather, class)
```

```{r}
p_jcr_precip <- jcr_weather |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(dayRain_c, monthRain_c, yearRain_c),
    names_to = "type",
    values_to = "rain_c"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    type = case_when(
      type == "dayRain_c" ~ "Daily Precipitation",
      type == "monthRain_c" ~ "Monthly Precipitation",
      type == "yearRain_c" ~ "Annual Precipitation"
    ),
    type = factor(
      type,
      levels = c(
        "Daily Precipitation",
        "Monthly Precipitation",
        "Annual Precipitation"
      )
    )
  ) |>

  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = utcdatetime,
      y = rain_c,
      color = type
    )
  ) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  scale_x_datetime(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%Y %b") +
  labs(
    x = "Date",
    y = "Precipitation (inches)",
    color = ""
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

p_jcr_precip

```

```{r}
jcr_weather |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(dayRain_c, monthRain_c, yearRain_c),
    names_to = "type",
    values_to = "rain_c"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    type = case_when(
      type == "dayRain_c" ~ "Daily Precipitation",
      type == "monthRain_c" ~ "Monthly Precipitation",
      type == "yearRain_c" ~ "Annual Precipitation"
    ),
    type = factor(
      type,
      levels = c(
        "Daily Precipitation",
        "Monthly Precipitation",
        "Annual Precipitation"
      )
    )
  ) |>
  filter(type == "Daily Precipitation") |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = utcdatetime,
      y = rain_c,
      color = type
    )
  ) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  scale_x_datetime(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%Y %b") +
  labs(
    x = "Date",
    y = "Precipitation (inches)",
    color = ""
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
```

```{r}
jcr_weather |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = utcdatetime,
      y = temp
    )
  ) +
  geom_line() +
  tidyquant::geom_ma(ma_fun = SMA, n = 365, linetype = "solid", color = "red") +
  scale_x_datetime(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%Y %b") +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "Temperature (F)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
```

# LOM weather


```{r}
lom_weather <- read_csv(
  "data/Weather Data/HICKS_CYN.csv",
  skip = 3
) |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  rename(
    datetime = date_and_time,
    precip = total
  ) |>
  mutate(datetime = lubridate::parse_date_time(datetime, "HMS mdy")) |>
  mutate(total_precip = cumsum(precip), total_precip_mm = total_precip * 25.4)

lom_weather |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = datetime,
      y = total_precip_mm
    )
  ) +
  geom_line() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "Cumulative Precipitation (mm)",
    title = "Loma Ridge (Hicks Canyon) Weather Station"
  )
```
